---
title: Built-in config-file languages
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # Each block resolves to a built-in grammar: the container carries
        # `sourceCode <class>` and the tokens wrap in `hl-*` spans. `conf`
        # is an alias of `toml` (Pandoc resolves `conf` through TOML's
        # `*.conf` glob), and `Dockerfile` matches `dockerfile` because
        # class names match case-insensitively. PowerShell is included too.
        # The ini and Dockerfile comments must come out as `hl-comment`:
        # their upstream queries also capture comments as `@spell`, which
        # must not win. (Comment nodes may include the line break, so only
        # the opening is matched.)
        - [!str "<pre class=\"sourceCode ini\"",
           !str "hl-comment\">; Widget settings",
           !str "hl-property\">host</span>",
           !str "<pre class=\"sourceCode toml\"",
           !str "hl-string\">&quot;localhost&quot;</span>",
           !str "<pre class=\"sourceCode conf\"",
           !str "hl-string\">&quot;0.0.0.0:3939&quot;</span>",
           !str "<pre class=\"sourceCode xml\"",
           !str "hl-tag\">server</span>",
           !str "<pre class=\"sourceCode Dockerfile\"",
           !str "hl-comment\"># Build stage",
           !str "hl-keyword\">FROM</span>",
           !str "<pre class=\"sourceCode powershell\"",
           !str "hl-string\">&quot;widget&quot;</span>"]
---

Configuration files are common in technical documentation. These
languages are highlighted without any setup.

```ini
; Widget settings
[server]
host = localhost
port = 8080
```

```toml
[server]
host = "localhost"
port = 8080
debug = false
```

```conf
listen = "0.0.0.0:3939"
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<server host="localhost" port="8080">ok</server>
```

```Dockerfile
# Build stage
FROM rust:1.80 AS build
RUN cargo build --release
```

```powershell
$name = "widget"
Restart-Service -Name $name -Force
```
